message.dotcraftenergy.kite.none: No kite. Use a kite on the generator; sneak with an empty hand to take it back.
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.current.axis: Front and back must stay free for the water (a solid block there: 0 FE); gives FE to the other sides
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.current.formula: Needs water: peak x water share x biome x (1 + animals)
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.current.perk_1: Baseline: needs a nearly full cube of water
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.current.perk_2: Wide net: animals count within 6 blocks
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.current.perk_3: Adaptation: keeps 75% outside ocean and river
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.current.perk_4: Lean water: a small pond is already enough
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.kite.perk.1: Plain kite: needs a free 3x3 way up, rain halves the output, a storm reels it in.
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.kite.perk.2: Waxed line: rain costs only a quarter.
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.kite.perk.3: Rain-proof sail; ignores obstructions: blocks above and a crowded sky cost nothing.
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.kite.perk.4: Storm line: flies in a thunderstorm at half output; a crowded sky costs half as much. Two kites share the base. Lightning on the kite: 1,000,000 FE, rarely.
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.kite.perk.5: Insulated tether: ignores thunder and a crowded sky. Two kites share the base. Lightning on the kite: 1,000,000 FE, rarely.
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.kite.tether: Tether: %s m (the longer, the more FE: output = base x tether / 32)
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.thermo: Peak %1$s FE/t at a temperature difference of %2$s
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.thermo.hint: Needs a hot and a cold neighbour on opposite sides (levels 1-3 each, they add up to the difference)
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.vibration.hearing: Hears shocks within %1$s blocks, from vibration frequency %2$s
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.vibration.needs: Powered by shocks nearby: blocks broken, fights, explosions
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.vibration.peak: Peak %1$s FE/t, on average at most %2$s FE/t
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.wheel.perk.2: Bigger cage: more mobs and a wider zone.
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.wheel.perk.3: Small animals pull their full weight.
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.wheel.perk.4: Gearbox: more mobs keep their weight.
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.wheel.perk.5: Flywheel: keeps turning for a few seconds after the mobs stop.
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.wheel.rules: Animals that run in the zone drive it: no babies, no hurt animals, no animals in water, one wheel per animal. A comparator reads the load.
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.wheel.stats: Up to %1$s FE/t, zone radius %2$s, up to %3$s mobs
